uplink.description: Status report, both probes dry (no leak)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame; expected.data derived by running reference/upstream-codec.js (Volt 30/10 = 3 V, WaterLeak_1 NoLeak, WaterLeak_2 NoLeak) and mapping each probe to its own channels[] entry.

uplink.description: Probes differ: probe0 dry, probe1 wet (per-position truth, unrepresentable in the old any-probe OR)
uplink._note: TTN example "Status report" input (reference/upstream-examples.json). Upstream oracle: Volt 3, WaterLeak_1 NoLeak (bytes[4]=0 -> probe0 leak false), WaterLeak_2 Leak (bytes[5]=1 -> probe1 leak true). The two probes disagree, so this is the case the retired top-level any-probe OR could not express.

uplink.description: Probes differ the other way: probe0 wet, probe1 dry
uplink._note: Synthetic mirror of the TTN status example with the probe bytes swapped; cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js (WaterLeak_1 Leak, WaterLeak_2 NoLeak). Pins entry order to the wire order: bytes[4] -> probe0, bytes[5] -> probe1.

uplink.description: Status report, both probes leaking with low battery
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame; byte3 0x9E has the low-battery high bit set (0x1E = 30 -> 3 V). Reference decodes Volt '3(low battery)', both probes Leak. battery / lowBattery are whole-device readings and stay top-level.
Synthetic in-bounds config-report response; fPort 7 carries configuration, not a measurement.
